overview: Repentigny had 86,100 residents in the 2021 Census, up 2.2 percent since 2016. Those residents live in 34,174 occupied dwellings packed into just 61.52 square kilometres, which makes it one of the denser suburbs around Montreal and leaves almost no vacant land.

Growth now comes through redevelopment, such as the Avantia project in the industrial park, rather than new subdivisions. Galeries Rive Nord pulls shoppers from across Lanaudière. For a local business, that means a compact, established customer base that is easy to reach, but where winning customers usually means taking them from a competitor.
